## A reproducible released reference

The strongest score-bound public reference found in this audit is **Budget-Fit V5**, by **Wilmer E. Henao (verracodeguacas)**. Its **0.18** was tied to that exact version in the 11 October primary UI observation; it is the upstream notebook's score. This section reproduces the original four compiler inputs and ZIP container unchanged. It does not claim that our copy has earned 0.18.

[Original scored notebook, V5](https://www.kaggle.com/code/verracodeguacas/gemma-4-agent-budget-fit-single-agent?scriptVersionId=355310852) · Apache-2.0 terms and full attribution accompany the output.

One coder, 28 tool calls, an eight-minute policy cap, 80 turns and 240-second commands form one complete recipe. Temperature 0.2, top-p 0.95, 8,192 output tokens and 4,096 thinking tokens are retained. The declared model is **Gemma 4 31B QAT W4A16**, not a 4B-parameter substitute.

Run the next cell to produce a byte-exact reference in a new folder. Set `GEMMA_REFERENCE_OUTPUT` before running if your working directory differs. Existing folders are preserved; choose a fresh output name for another experiment. No GPU is needed for archive reproduction. Native compiler/model/tool/grading and complete runtime checks remain separate from reproduction.

import base64, hashlib, io, json, os, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
UPSTREAM_URL = 'https://www.kaggle.com/code/verracodeguacas/gemma-4-agent-budget-fit-single-agent?scriptVersionId=355310852'
UPSTREAM_AUTHOR = 'Wilmer E. Henao (verracodeguacas)'
ZIP_SHA256 = '1cb73986bd9ad1682896d56516cfd3df7f4d5729c7ecfe7afda109c175dbbb94'
MEMBERS = {'agent.yaml': '680799291cc7d156d06fb7bfb5577f683ccc0d555b00e8ddb662d577f9bfa5e4', 'configs/sampling.yaml': '571a934e89911734927533f1d36cbcc7b8d493592febe63b217e911cf7ed4926', 'eval_config.yaml': '916cf6cb34a6cc3de39837fa72cac681599b9ac2a3ee0b893adadfd36474c531', 'prompts/system.md': '475cc9b7fcc0dc295532f5cb5e1928f26a491f501837ad08b1c79bdbe1a3eaa4'}
ARCHIVE_B64 = ''

def inspect_archive(raw: bytes) -> dict:
    if type(raw) is not bytes or len(raw) > 65536:
        raise ValueError("Reference byte envelope")
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != ZIP_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("Exact upstream ZIP changed")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
        entries = archive.infolist()
        if [entry.filename for entry in entries] != list(MEMBERS):
            raise ValueError("Four ordered compiler members required")
        if sum(entry.file_size for entry in entries) > 32768:
            raise ValueError("Reference unpacked envelope")
        observed = {}
        for entry in entries:
            if entry.is_dir() or entry.flag_bits & 1 or entry.file_size > 16384:
                raise ValueError("Unexpected reference member")
            content = archive.read(entry)
            if hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() != MEMBERS[entry.filename]:
                raise ValueError("Reference member changed")
            content.decode("utf-8", "strict")
            observed[entry.filename] = {"sha256": MEMBERS[entry.filename], "bytes": len(content)}
    return {"status": "BYTE_EXACT_RELEASED_REFERENCE", "zip_sha256": ZIP_SHA256,
            "zip_bytes": len(raw), "members": observed, "upstream": UPSTREAM_URL,
            "native_qualified": False, "own_official_score": None}

Later source/output-list reads confirmed the same V5 identity; they did not expose a new numeric score. This is the upstream reference's result, not a result achieved by our copy. "

### The next experiment

A minimal route canary uses one preselected, already exposed public development task in its registered order. It runs the unchanged full eight-minute policy through the original setup and scorer. Startup, generation, commands, grading and cleanup are timed separately; every failure stays in the denominator. This tests compiler/serving/tool/patch/grading readiness and bounded runtime. It cannot establish held-out quality or predict an official leaderboard score.

After that, evaluate a registered development panel and whole-workload runtime before an official upload. Any later prompt, tool or budget change gets its own package identity. A different notebook name with identical package bytes is the same policy lineage, not a new architecture.
